yt_title: The gas station sign started counting down. Part 1 #shorts

scenes.text: There's a gas station at mile eighty-eight on a desert highway. The nearest town is fifty miles away.
You work the night shift. Alone. Most nights, nobody stops.
The only thing to look at is the price sign out front.
Tonight, it changes. It doesn't show a price anymore. Just a number.
A truck rolls past on the highway. You check the camera.
Every car that passes, the number drops by one. You start counting headlights.
You text your manager. Is the sign supposed to do that?
scenes.title: Message

scenes.text: One more car is coming. You know that car.
It's yours. And your car is still parked outside.
